plan.request: Review the operator-supplied versioned read-only Notion observation export for the project-decisions database using its authorization and scope receipt, propose links between duplicate topics, and identify decisions older than six months that need owner review.
observationGoals: Find repeated topic records without merging them
Identify decisions older than the owner-defined threshold
Find conflicts, broken or missing links and properties, and orphan candidates
Prepare reversible exact-version proposals for human review

conventions.naming: Use a decision subject followed by an ISO decision date; preserve existing titles until a rename is approved externally.
conventions.linking: Use reciprocal Topic and Related decision relations within the project-decisions database.
conventions.properties: Decision owner and Review state are required on decision pages.
conventions.archive: Archive only after a named owner confirms the page is superseded and a rollback target is recorded.
conventions.retention: Project decision records retain through 2032-12-31 unless the records owner supplies a stricter policy.

issues.description: Two distinct records share the observed api-versioning topic fingerprint; both identities remain present.
The decision's exact last-edited time is older than the owner's 180-day review threshold.
Two authoritative exact-version decision records preserve opposing hosting-boundary positions; neither is selected.
The notes page exposes a broken reference to a legacy Notion page.
The project-decisions database has no observed API summary page relation.
The duplicate topic record has no decision-owner relation.
The topic record lacks the required Decision owner property.
The page has zero observed inbound references and remains only an orphan candidate for owner review.

operations.patchIntent: Propose a reciprocal topic relation between the two observed api-versioning records while preserving both pages.

rollback.instruction: A human can remove the proposed reciprocal topic relation and restore the exact observed null value.

operations.patchIntent: Propose marking the stale decision for owner review without changing the decision itself.

rollback.instruction: A human can restore the exact observed Review state value.

operations.patchIntent: Propose a convention-aligned title while retaining the original observed title in the rollback patch.

rollback.instruction: A human can restore the exact observed title.

operations.patchIntent: Propose a source-linked draft page title; page creation remains an external human action.

rollback.instruction: A human can discard the uncreated proposal or remove an externally created draft under a separate receipt-bound workflow.

operations.patchIntent: Propose moving the orphan candidate under the observed API versioning decision after owner review.

rollback.instruction: A human can restore the exact observed project-decisions database parent.

operations.patchIntent: Preserve this archive proposal as blocked until a human resolves the conflict without removing either observed side.

rollback.instruction: A human can restore the exact observed unarchived state while retaining both conflict records.

blockers.description: The decision owner must choose whether the stale record needs review before a property proposal can be approved.
A named decision owner must review every hosting-conflict side; the plan cannot resolve or archive either position.

questions.question: Should Sam Rivera review the API versioning decision before a human changes its Review state?
Which named human or team will own a separate decision process that preserves and reviews both hosting positions?

handoff.summary: A private exact-version plan preserves duplicate topics and every hosting-conflict side, with one operation-specific human approval and all other changes proposed or blocked for external application.
